title: Feathered Friend
subject: English
summary: “Feathered Friend” is a chapter about the beauty and importance of birds in our lives. It describes how birds make nature beautiful with their colourful feathers, sweet songs and different activities. Birds help maintain the balance of nature by spreading seeds and controlling insects. They build nests, lay eggs and take care of their young ones. The chapter encourages us to observe birds and understand their importance in the environment. It also reminds us to protect their homes and provide a safe environment for them. The chapter teaches us that we should love, care for and protect birds and other living creatures.
